patch_description: The current program's dynamic thresholding and volatility-adjusted exits increased the drawdown significantly (0.36 vs. the seed's 0.25), resulting in a lower combined score despite a higher total return. This edit reverts the core logic to the robust parameters of the highest-performing seed (0.002 threshold, 0.004/0.003 TP/SL, and 0.10 position size) while adding high-value microstructure filters (VWAP deviation, funding rate, and stricter OBI) to improve the win rate and reduce drawdown further.
